comment: Expo reads the `expo` key only; this note is ignored by the CLI. userInterfaceStyle is pinned to light on purpose - an undesigned dark mode is worse than none, and the palette in src/theme/tokens.ts is tuned for direct sunlight on a cheap LCD, not for a dark room.
